lines.text: The whole world had one language, and people journeying eastward settled on a plain in the land of Goshen.
They proposed making and thoroughly baking bricks, and used brick instead of stone and tar instead of mortar.
They wanted a city and a tower reaching the heavens, to make a name for themselves and not be scattered.
The LORD came down to see the city and tower, and said He would go down and send fire.
The LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth, and the city was called Babel.
